QuestInfo.name: Shumi on the Dyle
QuestInfo.1: #p1052102# says that #m103000000#'s sewers have been extra funny lately. Apparently #bNella#k was going on about the sewers recently, so you should ask her about it.

1.0: Huh? I don't have a job for you right now.

npc.0: Maybe Nella knows something about Dyle.

0.0: (...I can't let on that I lost my bag again! Just be cool, Shumi. Be cool.) H-hello! How're you doing? What can I do for you? Yes? Yes? What is it?

yes.0: I don't know a whole lot about Dyle, but I smelled something really nasty in the sewers the other day... Of course the sewer smells, but this was different. Like #rtwo smells mixed together#k... Maybe it's related to #o6220000#? I don't know.
yes.1: Why don't you ask Nella? She might know something.

no.0: Huh? Just stopping by to say hi?
